text.text_excerpt: We've been owners of Worldmark for nearly 16 years, but this was our first trip to Avenue Plaza. We booked two studios -- one for my husband and I and one for our friends traveling with us. The studios were furnished nicely, had kitchens, but no adequate mirror. The only mirror was the tiny mirror above the bathroom sink. To see myself fully dressed, I used the mirror out in the hallway by the elevator. Yeah, that was weird but it wouldn't prevent me from staying here again. The staff were overwhelmingly friendly, genuine and appreciative of us. Each morning, we received a "Good morning" when passing the front desk. Upon return in the evening, we received a, "Hello" or, "How was your day"...

Our stay at the Avenue Plaza Resort started off a little rocky, but we were VERY HAPPY with our stay as the days progressed. A big part of our satisfaction was due to the EXCELLENT customer service given to us by Dwight B. Thanks Dwight! First off, getting to the hotel was easy by public transportation. It beats the $38 (R/T) airport shuttle people were trying to sell us at the airport. Take the E2 Airport Express bus to the CBD (Central Business District). The bus stop is on the second level of the airport. Make sure to have $2 exactly because no change is provided. Get off in CBD at the intersection of Tulane and Loyola. (E2 bus ride is about 45 min to 1 hour to/from CBD) Walk 5 blks to...

I hesitate to tell anyone about this place because I don't want it to be booked when I come back to New Orleans. It is a timeshare location and I believe you must be an owner in order to stay. Great location on the edge of the Garden District away from the crowds downtown but close to restaurants, drug store, markets, and transportation. The St. Charles Ave Streetcar stops right in front and can take you to the French Quarter or The Zoo in minutes. The room was a king/studio. There is a small pool and hot tub in a lovely courtyard as well as a useful business center. A really well equipped gym, and a rooftop deck. The staff was friendly and helpful. I would always stay here!
